property_summary: For every admissible call, C transfers its full balance to the caller if and only if block.number % 15 == 0 (so the contract is left with 0 ether on payout blocks and 20 ether otherwise); the mutant inverts this, draining on non-payout blocks, violating the rule for blocks where block.number % 15 != 0.
change_summary: Replace the payout condition `block.number % 15 == 0` with `block.number % 15 != 0`, inverting which blocks pay out.
